findings.description: The proposed tests contain a streak-counting ambiguity: F001 says clearance_streak counts consecutive full-clearance rounds ending at the latest round, but F003 expects C0 round 3 to have streak=2 while rounds 1-2 are not eligible despite the stated 100% clearance across rounds 1-3.
findings.recommendation: Pin whether the latest round is included in the streak and align the C0 round expectations before implementation starts.

findings.description: The plan does not explicitly require the full completion-path test where an eligible high matrix_pin refusal is followed by recording waived_matrix_pin_high and then the same lock succeeds without any paid auditor invocation.
findings.recommendation: Add an end-to-end offline fixture for the real C0 eligible round: refusal names eligibility, disposition with valid confirmation is recorded, and lock then passes with the auditor-call guard unchanged.

findings.description: The fallback_blocked journey state is named in the objective, and F001 mentions conservative-fallback findings, but F003 only calls out plan_contract discrimination fixtures and does not require a concrete fallback-classed or unclassified high blocker case.
findings.recommendation: Add an explicit high conservative-fallback fixture proving it blocks lock and refuses waived_matrix_pin_high even when the clearance streak threshold is met.

findings.description: F002 asks the refusal output to name the exact disposition command, but also forbids default confirmation text anywhere in the path. That leaves the CLI contract under-specified and risks either a non-runnable command or an accidental canned confirmation.
findings.recommendation: Specify the exact CLI shape with a required operator-supplied confirmation argument or placeholder, and ensure placeholder text itself is not accepted as valid confirmation.
